lessons_used: Predictions were generally overoptimistic for non-winning tests, but underpredicted gains for winning tests.
sign_in hint, home wait_info, and adoption new_flow were helpful changes as each won a test.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as each has only been tested once.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Welcome Overlay Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated completion screen explaining basic desktop pet controls like clicking to talk and right-clicking to hide.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

new_controls_overview.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_overview.body: Click your pet on the desktop to interact, or right-click its tray icon to hide or adjust settings anytime.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Pet Adoption Certificate Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen using a full bleed layout with a prominent official stamp badge.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high drop-off (66% completion) and long mean duration (1017s); visual certificate clarity aids completion.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Photo Style Selector Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive style selector choice card during photo upload to allow users to preview and pick a rendering style before creation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected.

guard.reason: Adds an interactive render style selection component to the upload photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Targeting 34% drop-off step with a proven winning new_flow change type (+4.6% past lift).

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Story Sequence Reorder
candidates.change: Reorders the onboarding sequence so that the story screen appears right after sign in.
candidates.why: Sign-in takes mean 567s with 23.9% drop-off; moving story right after sign-in reduces early friction.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Notification Hint
candidates.change: Adds a explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in will automatically restore previously created pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the highest reported issue) noted pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically syncs and restores all your existing desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adds an informational sync hint to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Solves #1 support email complaint (8 emails) with a low-cost, proven winning hint change.

candidates.title: Generation Progress Time Estimate Display
candidates.change: Displays an estimated remaining time and dynamic progress bar on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading to high drop-off due to lack of feedback.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Please hang tight while your custom pet companion is prepared.

guard.reason: Displays a time estimate and progress bar during an actual generation wait.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 2336s home wait duration using a past winning change type (+3.9% past lift).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Hatch Ready System Alert
candidates.change: Enables the system notification switch on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet has finished loading.
candidates.why: Home wait time is long (mean 2336s), so desktop notifications ensure users return when generation completes.

waiting.hint: Enable notifications to get alerted the moment your pet appears on screen.

guard.reason: Adds an optional notification toggle to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets long home wait time via desktop alert; previous test showed modest +0.6% gain.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Desktop Launch Headline Copy
candidates.change: Updates the headline and call-to-action button on the final home intro screen to direct users to look at their desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that pets did not show on desktop or the app would not open.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look around your screen corners to interact with your pet now.

guard.reason: Updates headline and CTA copy on the home intro overlay within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step (35.2%) and 3 support emails, though copy changes have mixed track record.

candidates.title: Quick Desktop Companion Choice Badge
candidates.change: Adds a badge on the path selection screen highlighting the fast setup path.
candidates.why: Choose path takes mean 514s; encouraging the quick adoption path reduces initial drop-off.

guard.reason: Adds an informational badge to the path selection screen.

candidates.score_note: Encourages faster path selection for 514s mean duration step via low-cost UI badge.

candidates.title: Story Screen Compact Layout Overview
candidates.change: Switches the story screen layout to compact to deliver intro context without extensive scrolling.
candidates.why: Initial path selection step has long mean duration (514s); a compact presentation speeds up early onboarding.

guard.reason: Changes the story screen layout to compact while keeping its core job intact.

candidates.score_note: Compact layout reduces long 514s choose_path duration; backed by +1.7% single-test result.
